import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                     c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='YlOrRd', s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality\n(colored by Stress Level)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1, label='Stress Level')
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=15, color=colors[0], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors[:len(bmi_counts)], startangle=90, explode=[0.05]*len(bmi_counts))
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Physical Activity Level by BMI Category
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
bmi_present = [cat for cat in bmi_order if cat in df['BMI Category'].unique()]
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Physical Activity Level', 
            order=bmi_present, palette='Set2', ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity by BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
sleep_disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
bars = ax5.bar(range(len(sleep_disorder_counts)), sleep_disorder_counts.values, 
               color=colors[:len(sleep_disorder_counts)], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(sleep_disorder_counts)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(sleep_disorder_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Heart Rate vs Daily Steps
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
ax6.scatter(df['Daily Steps'], df['Heart Rate'], c=colors[3], s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
ax6.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate vs Daily Steps', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 7. Stress Level Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
stress_counts = df['Stress Level'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax7.bar(stress_counts.index, stress_counts.values, color=colors[4], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_xlabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Stress Level Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 8. Occupation Distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
occupation_counts = df['Occupation'].value_counts()
ax8.barh(range(len(occupation_counts)), occupation_counts.values, color=colors[:len(occupation_counts)], 
         edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax8.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_counts)))
ax8.set_yticklabels(occupation_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax8.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_title('Occupation Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 9. Correlation Heatmap
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0, 
            square=True, ax=ax9, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, annot_kws={'size': 8})
ax9.set_title('Correlation Matrix', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=8)

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
